articles.title: SHOCKER in Parliament! Rahul Gandhi Says 'Fking' Instead of 'Fighting' While Referring to Pakistan
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: New Delhi – A major slip of the tongue by Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi in the Lok Sabha on Monday has gone viral.

body.html:
New Delhi – A major slip of the tongue by Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi in the Lok Sabha on Monday has gone viral. While speaking about national security, Gandhi mistakenly said, “They were not f**king Pakistan” instead of “fighting Pakistan.”

The unintentional expletive left many stunned in the House and sparked a storm on social media.

Critics called it a serious lapse in parliamentary decorum, while supporters claimed it was an innocent verbal error during a passionate speech.

articles.title: Russia's Kamchatka Hit by 8.7 Quake, 4m Tsunami Waves Slam Coastline | Alerts in Japan, US
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kamchatka, Russia – A massive earthquake measuring 8.7 on the Richter scale struck Russia's Far Eastern Kamchatka Peninsula on Wednesday morning, triggering tsunami waves up to 4 metres and causing widespread panic and damage.

body.html:
Kamchatka, Russia – A massive earthquake measuring 8.7 on the Richter scale struck Russia's Far Eastern Kamchatka Peninsula on Wednesday morning, triggering tsunami waves up to 4 metres and causing widespread panic and damage.

Epicentre: 133 km southeast of Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky, at a depth of 74 km.

⚠️ Tsunami Alerts Issued:
Countries under warning include Russia, Japan, USA, Hawaii, Alaska, and other Pacific coastal nations.

💥 Reported Damage:
● Coastal buildings shook violently; balconies collapsed.
● Kindergarten damaged, several people injured.
● Power and mobile networks disrupted in Kamchatka.
● Evacuations underway in affected areas.
● Japan's Hokkaido and nearby islands also under tsunami threat.

USGS termed it one of the strongest tremors in decades.
Tokyo University seismologist Shinichi Sakai warned that shallow epicentres greatly increase tsunami risk, even in far-off locations.

articles.title: Shocking! Thar Driver Rams Elderly Man in Broad Daylight in Jammu – Caught on CCTV!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing video from Jammu has surfaced on social media, showing a deliberate hit-and-run involving an elderly man and a Thar SUV.

body.html:
A disturbing video from Jammu has surfaced on social media, showing a deliberate hit-and-run involving an elderly man and a Thar SUV. The incident took place around 1:30 PM on Sunday (July 27) on the road from Gandhi Nagar to Greenbelt Park, and has left netizens outraged over the brazen act of violence.

The CCTV footage captures the chilling moment when the elderly man, riding a scooter, collides with a Thar near Allora Textiles. He falls, but manages to stand up—only to be intentionally rammed again as the Thar driver reverses at high speed, sending the senior citizen sliding several feet across the road.

Eyewitnesses rushed the injured man to the hospital. His condition is reported to be stable.

Following public outcry, police have lodged an FIR under multiple serious sections of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) including:
● Section 281 – Negligent driving,
● Section 109 – Attempt to murder,
● Section 125(A) – Endangering human life.

The accused driver, identified as Manan Anand, is currently absconding. Authorities believe he has fled the city. In a swift move, police have seized the Thar and taken Manan’s father, Rajinder Anand, into custody, as he is the vehicle's registered owner.

Witnesses also noted that a young man exited the Thar after the incident, exchanged words with the victim and bystanders, and then fled the scene.

The graphic nature of the video has sparked calls for justice, with many demanding the immediate arrest of Manan Anand and stricter laws against such reckless and intentional violence.

articles.title: 25-Year-Old Collapses Mid-Game at Hyderabad Stadium — Dies of Sudden Heart Attack Caught on CCTV
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 25-year-old youth collapsed and died of a suspected heart attack while playing shuttle badminton at Nagole Stadium, Hyderabad, on Sunday. The tragic moment was caught on CCTV, which shows the young man suddenly collapsing mid-game as fellow players rushed to his aid.

body.html:
A 25-year-old youth collapsed and died of a suspected heart attack while playing shuttle badminton at Nagole Stadium, Hyderabad, on Sunday. The tragic moment was caught on CCTV, which shows the young man suddenly collapsing mid-game as fellow players rushed to his aid.

The deceased was identified as Gundla Rakesh, son of Gundla Venkateshwarlu, a former deputy sarpanch of Tallada in Khammam district. Rakesh was working in a private company in Hyderabad.

Despite being rushed to the hospital immediately, doctors declared him brought dead. Preliminary medical reports indicate he may have suffered a cardiac arrest during the game.

This incident has once again sparked concerns over the rising number of heart-related deaths among young people, especially during or after physical activity.

articles.title: Car Swallowed by Massive Sinkhole on Busy Singapore Road — Woman Rescued Just in Time!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman had a miraculous escape after her car was swallowed by a sudden sinkhole that opened up on a busy Singapore road in broad daylight.

body.html:
A woman had a miraculous escape after her car was swallowed by a sudden sinkhole that opened up on a busy Singapore road in broad daylight. The shocking incident occurred on July 26 around 5 PM near the junction of Tanjong Katong Road and Mountbatten Road, close to the One Amber condominium.

The dramatic visuals, now viral on social media, show the car almost completely submerged in a gaping, water-filled hole, with only its front barely visible. Onlookers can be heard gasping as water gushes into the pit, making the scene even more terrifying.

Singapore’s Public Utilities Board (PUB) confirmed the incident and said that two lanes of the road were affected. Thankfully, the woman trapped inside was rescued safely before the situation worsened.

The cause of the sinkhole is under investigation, and PUB officials have initiated repair and inspection work in the area.

Citizens praised the quick emergency response and called for stronger infrastructure checks, especially given Singapore’s reputation for efficient urban planning.

articles.title: “World’s Highest Dump?” Viral Video Shows Mount Everest Base Camp Covered in Trash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A deeply disturbing video from Mount Everest is going viral on social media, showing piles of human waste, scattered tents, and trash left behind by climbers at one of the base camps.

body.html:
A deeply disturbing video from Mount Everest is going viral on social media, showing piles of human waste, scattered tents, and trash left behind by climbers at one of the base camps. The visuals, shared by popular X handle @AMAZlNGNATURE, have sparked widespread outrage online—especially among environmentalists, trekkers, and nature lovers.

The post claims Everest is now buried under 12,000 kg (26,500 lbs) of human excrement, along with general garbage and leftover climbing gear. With more than 4 million views, the video has ignited serious debate over the impact of human tourism on one of the planet’s most iconic and fragile environments.

Once revered as the “roof of the world,” Mount Everest is now drawing attention for all the wrong reasons.

One furious user wrote, “Congrats humanity—we’ve managed to litter the top of the world too.” Another commented, “It wasn’t the locals who destroyed Everest, it’s the rich tourists chasing enlightenment and leaving their sht behind—literally.”*

New 2024 rules mandate climbers to carry back their own waste, but years of accumulated garbage and neglect have left the mountain’s campsites in a horrifying state. The video shows clearly how unregulated tourism and big-money expeditions are damaging the very wilderness people come to admire.

articles.title: Thief Fires Shots While 70 Villagers Chase Him in Rampur—Bollywood-Style

articles.excerpt: Rampur, UP – A dramatic chase scene straight out of a Bollywood film unfolded in Tin Wali Masjid Mohalla of Rampur, where a thief was seen firing two shots while being chased by over 70 villagers. The entire incident was caught on CCTV and is now going viral on social media.

body.html:
Rampur, UP – A dramatic chase scene straight out of a Bollywood film unfolded in Tin Wali Masjid Mohalla of Rampur, where a thief was seen firing two shots while being chased by over 70 villagers. The entire incident was caught on CCTV and is now going viral on social media.

In the footage, the thief is seen running through a narrow lane while firing in the air. Behind him, dozens of villagers—some half-dressed, others clearly unprepared—can be seen sprinting after him. One man was even spotted mixing ‘gutkha’ in his hands while chasing.

Thankfully, no injuries have been reported yet. Police have launched an investigation and are on the lookout for the armed thief. Meanwhile, the viral video has sparked a flood of hilarious reactions online, with many comparing it to iconic movie climax scenes.
